# @bun-erp/ui

Shared atomic React UI for the web and mobile apps. Import a component from its layer subpath. There
is no eager package barrel; each subpath points to one source module and can be tree-shaken. Only
`@bun-erp/ui/styles.css` has package side effects. Components do not read routes, permissions, RPC
clients, or feature state. Shared, reduced-motion-aware list animation is exposed from
`@bun-erp/ui/lib/use-auto-animate.ts`.

## Layers

- `atoms`: aspect ratio, badge, button, card, checkbox, input, input OTP slots, keyboard key, label,
  marker, native select, progress, separator, skeleton, slider, spinner, switch, textarea, toggle,
  typography, and small display primitives.
- `molecules`: accordion, alert, attachment, avatar, breadcrumb, bubble, button group, calendar,
  collapsible, command, empty, field, hover card, input group, item, message, pagination, popover,
  radio group, scroll area, select, Table primitive, tabs, toggle group, tooltip, and form helpers.
- `organisms`: alert dialog, carousel, context menu, dialog, direction provider, drawer, dropdown
  menu, date picker, menubar, message scroller, navigation menu, questionnaire, resizable panels,
  sheet, sidebar, toast, and application compositions.
- `templates`: login, signup, and sidebar layout blocks plus the shared page shell.

## Import examples

```tsx
import { Button } from "@bun-erp/ui/atoms/button-primitives";
import { useSoftAutoAnimate } from "@bun-erp/ui/lib/use-auto-animate.ts";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableRow } from "@bun-erp/ui/molecules/table";
import { DatePicker } from "@bun-erp/ui/organisms/date-picker";
import { SidebarBlock } from "@bun-erp/ui/templates/sidebar-block";
```

Use `useSoftAutoAnimate` on the parent of a short collection whose children are inserted, removed
or reordered. It uses the shared 200 ms panel-easing preset and honors `prefers-reduced-motion`. The
hook also accepts an AutoAnimate keyframe plugin for a component with a deliberate custom motion
need. Give mapped React children stable, unique keys. Do not animate every page or a table's rows by
default; add motion only where it helps users track a state change.

Motion is defined once in `@bun-erp/ui/styles.css` as `--motion-duration-fast|base|panel` and
`--motion-ease-enter|exit`. Overlays, menus, popovers, selects, tooltips, dialogs and disclosure
sections animate on open and on close through those tokens, so closing never snaps harder than
opening. A global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block disables every one of them along
with the list hook's AutoAnimate preset, so components do not each re-check the preference.

Explicit `.tsx` imports are supported too. Existing app-facing modules keep their current API paths;
where those overlap an upstream API, import the complete shadcn component from the sibling
`*-primitives` module. Do not add a package root export that eagerly loads every component.

## Official shadcn catalog

The 57 vendored registry components are pinned to commit
`295a1f114a138f23b5dfee0e0c6812394dfeb90c` from the official New York v4 registry. Their source URLs,
registry item references, MIT license and package import adaptations are recorded in
`component-sources.json`; the upstream MIT notice is in `LICENSE.upstream`.

The catalog includes Accordion, Alert, Alert Dialog, Aspect Ratio, Attachment, Avatar, Badge,
Breadcrumb, Bubble, Button, Button Group, Calendar, Card, Carousel, Checkbox, Collapsible, Command,
Context Menu, Dialog, Direction, Drawer, Dropdown Menu, Empty, Field, Hover Card, Input, Input Group,
Input OTP, Item, Kbd, Label, Marker, Menubar, Message, Message Scroller, Native Select, Navigation
Menu, Pagination, Popover, Progress, Radio Group, Resizable, Scroll Area, Select, Separator, Sheet,
Sidebar, Skeleton, Slider, Spinner, Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Toggle, Toggle Group and Tooltip.

Combobox continues to use the repository’s Radix and cmdk composition because the current official
registry source uses Base UI. Date Picker, Questionnaire, Toast and Typography are implemented from
the official documentation patterns because those docs do not publish registry JSON items. Chart
and Data Table patterns have separate package ownership and are not duplicated here.

## Blocks and custom patterns

`LoginBlock` and `SignupBlock` return submitted fields through callbacks; the app owns identity,
validation policy and submission. `SidebarBlock` composes the shadcn Sidebar and leaves links,
permissions and routing to the app. Date Picker composes Calendar and Popover. Questionnaire is a
multi-step controlled-answer composition. Custom source references and rationale are recorded in
`component-sources.json`.

## Migration notes

`organisms/data-table.tsx`, `organisms/resource-table.tsx` and the existing dashboard chart and
sparkline modules remain legacy compatibility exports until their dedicated packages land. New
Data Table usage belongs in `@bun-erp/data-table`; chart examples and renderers belong in the lazy,
runtime-isolated `@bun-erp/charts` package. `molecules/table` is the shadcn Table primitive and stays
in this package. The existing TanStack Table and Recharts dependency pins remain only for those
legacy modules during migration.
